steps.what: Read the actual environmental quality work plan, sampling instructions and applicable site limits in {DOCS}.
inputs: Engineer-issued work plan and applicable limit table
outputs: Actual inspection scope and versioned limits

steps.what: Perform the actual field or office environmental quality inspection, examining conditions and investigating hazards under the work plan.
Record actual location, time, parameter, reading, unit, instrument status and observations in the environmental inspection application {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual observations and readings from s2

steps.what: Compare recorded numerical readings against the exact approved parameter/unit limits using the inspection application's native rules {OTHER}.
outputs: Literal limit comparisons and missing-data flags

steps.what: Review the comparisons against actual conditions and decide what needs engineering investigation, without treating a within-limit result as environmental clearance.
outputs: Technician's actual findings and unresolved issues

steps.what: Save the inspection findings in the same environmental application {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure literal parameter and unit checks in the existing environmental inspection application {OTHER}. Actual environmental quality work, new observation capture and the interpretation of findings remain human; this does not control equipment or issue compliance clearance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual threshold comparison can be repeated after every inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rule fields can compare recorded values with versioned limits.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected environmental conditions may invalidate a simple numerical comparison.
tasks.human_edge: Notice hazards and interpret observations in their physical context.

ambition.what: Reduce a small comparison step without changing inspection authority.

tasks.altitude: The field inspection remains the main work.

reach.learn: Describe uncertainty and evidence that warrants engineering assessment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for inspection records and approved rules

evidence.claim: An inspection form can compare structured values with explicit limits; environmental interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual environmental inspection and its record, not a new reporting obligation. The physical work and its record are separate and fully retained.

Engineer-issued s1 limits have parameter, unit, site applicability, comparison operator and version; s3 supplies actual values, context and validity. Missing or incompatible fields produce an unresolved flag and manual comparison, never inferred values.
Conditional E1 activity estimates, not a measured baseline. Adopt only if manual comparisons actually occur; native rules are tested first. Routine same-system saving has no self-gate or saving.
unknowns: Are limits explicit and inspection records structured?
research_questions: Do rules correctly reject incompatible units and invalid measurements?

already_counted.description: Actual plan reading, field work, capture, interpretation and storage

incremental.description: Check rule versions and exception behaviour

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 5 minus 1 upkeep gives 4. Low 0 where the instrument or existing form already performs the comparison, so no new rule configuration is adopted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain project logbooks and program files

steps.what: Locate the actual project logbook entries, instrument exports and computer program files in {DOCS}.
inputs: Existing project records and program files

steps.what: Enter missing project identifiers, test dates, file versions and actual change explanations in the {DOCS} record properties.
outputs: Complete actual filing metadata and change explanations

steps.what: Copy and index the selected project logbook records and program-file versions into their project folders using native {DOCS} filing rules.
outputs: Draft indexed project record set with preserved originals

steps.what: Check actual logbook completeness, source links, file versions and whether the change explanations accurately describe the work.
inputs: Actual original files and explanations from s1-s2

steps.what: Save the corrected logbook and program-file index in the same {DOCS} workspace.

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} versioning, metadata views and filing rules for existing project files. The technician still supplies missing facts and checks the real contents; the machine performs the actual repeated copy/index action as its own step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Files are repeatedly located and copied into project structures by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and versioning can preserve and index selected files without semantic generation.
tasks.still_hard: A correctly named file can still describe the wrong test or omit an important change.
tasks.human_edge: Connect actual environmental work with the correct project history.

ambition.what: Provide an auditable program-version and test-record bundle for a project handover.

tasks.altitude: Less file handling, with technical record responsibility retained.

reach.learn: Preserve the lineage needed to reconstruct a test or remediation decision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for document permissions and retention settings

evidence.claim: Native document versioning and filing rules can replace repeated file copying when identifiers are explicit.

assumptions: Boundary is maintenance of already created records and files, including missing metadata and actual content checks. It does not assume new observations arrive structured for free.

s2 produces project id, source file id, date, version and actual change explanation. s3 copies only those selected files and preserves originals; uncertain ownership or conflicting versions return to the technician.

This conditional E1 baseline applies where copy/index work is manual today, not to existing automatic version storage. Native configuration precedes custom code. The final same-system save is 1% retained, without a self-approval stage.
unknowns: How much file copying is manual rather than existing runtime?
research_questions: Can every indexed version be recovered with its original content and project context?

already_counted.description: Source selection, missing metadata, content checks and routine storage

incremental.description: Maintain filing rules and resolve version conflicts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 5 retrieval plus 35 copying = 40; minus 2 upkeep gives 38. Low 0 when files are already natively versioned and indexed, so this proposal adds no labour saving and is not installed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select the actual laboratory or field data package, matching test results, photographs and observation notes to the correct sample and location.
inputs: Actual instrument export, photographs and observation notes in environmental data software {OTHER}

steps.what: Transfer actual numerical data and test results from the selected export into draft environmental records {OTHER} using the native import.
inputs: Actual export and sample mapping from s1
outputs: Imported numerical data draft with source references

steps.what: Attach the selected photographs to the mapped draft sample records in {OTHER} using their exact file identifiers.
outputs: Draft records with linked original photographs

steps.what: Write actual summaries of visual observations and relevant field context in the environmental records {OTHER}.
outputs: Complete draft records including actual visual summaries

steps.what: Check the recorded values, units, qualifiers, photograph identity and summary meaning against the actual source package.
Save the corrected data record in the same environmental software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Use native imports and exact photo-file links in environmental data software {OTHER}. The technician makes the source-to-sample mapping, writes the actual visual summaries and checks the completed record; no model invents observations from photographs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Numerical results and photo links may be re-entered from an existing source package.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports can preserve original values, qualifiers and file links.
tasks.still_hard: The wrong sample identifier can make an accurate result misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Supply and verify the observational context behind measurements.

ambition.what: Improve record traceability without changing environmental judgement.

tasks.altitude: Less re-keying; responsibility for the actual record stays with the technician.

reach.learn: Preserve qualifiers and sample lineage for engineering interpretation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for source exports and photo permissions

evidence.claim: Structured result imports and exact file links can replace manual numerical re-keying and photo attachment.

assumptions: Boundary is recording an actual source package. Sampling and original observation capture remain with the existing field/laboratory workflow and receive no saving here; their producers already supply the source package today.

Instrument export supplies sample id, test id, timestamp, value, unit and qualifier. Camera/field workers supply actual photo files and notes. The focal technician produces the verified sample and photo mapping in s1. Paper-only or ambiguous sources are keyed and checked manually; no free extraction is assumed.

Conditional E1 estimates describe a manual re-key/attachment scenario. Existing automatic import runtime receives no saving. Native import support is tested before custom code; actual summary writing and same-system save are fully retained, with no self-gate.
unknowns: Are exports machine-readable and is repeated re-keying actually present?
research_questions: Does an import preserve qualifiers and source identity on rejected and missing results?

already_counted.description: Source mapping, actual visual summaries, full record checking and storage

incremental.description: Check import mappings after instrument or record-schema changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25 numerical transfer plus 15 photo attachment = 40; minus 2 upkeep gives 38. Low 0 for already integrated instruments or paper-only sources where this native import is not adopted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual air or groundwater sampling and analysis method in {DOCS}, checking location, preservation and calculation requirements.
inputs: Engineer-issued method, sample plan and calculation definitions

steps.what: Collect the actual pollution samples using the required equipment, contamination controls and preservation method.
Record actual sample identifiers, collection times, location, preservation and field conditions in the sampling log {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual samples and field facts from s2

steps.what: Prepare and test the actual samples with the prescribed laboratory method and quality controls; inspect the instrument's measured results.
outputs: Actual instrument result export and quality-control observations

steps.what: Calculate the prescribed concentrations and quality-control summaries from the actual instrument export using validated analysis formulas in {OTHER}.
outputs: Traceable calculated pollution results and quality flags

steps.what: Interpret actual pollution results with blanks, recoveries, field conditions and method limits, recording unresolved validity concerns in {OTHER}.
outputs: Actual interpreted result record with limitations

steps.what: Save the result record in the same laboratory analysis software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure validated method calculations in the laboratory analysis software {OTHER}, using the actual instrument export and technician-recorded sample facts. Collection, sample preparation, testing and validity interpretation stay human; no model decides whether a site is safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method calculations can be repeated manually after testing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formula configurations can calculate traceable results from known instrument fields.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, poor recovery or unrepresentative sampling can invalidate a precise concentration.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when physical sampling and laboratory quality undermine the apparent result.

ambition.what: Return calculation time to examining sample validity.

tasks.altitude: The technician still collects and analyzes the actual samples.

reach.learn: Explain detection limits and quality-control failures without overstating conclusions.

evidence.claim: Validated formulas can automate specified analytical calculations; they do not establish sample validity.

assumptions: Boundary covers actual collection, field recording, laboratory analysis and result recording. No physical sampling or new observation capture is removed.

s1 provides the approved formula and units; s3 supplies actual sample ids and field facts; the existing instrument in s4 produces sample id, measured response, calibration version, blank/control readings and flags. Missing fields require manual calculation and investigation; no free interface or extraction is assumed.

Conditional E1 estimates only where calculations are manual today. Existing instrument runtime is not labour. Native method settings are tested before code; routine record storage is 1% fully retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Which methods permit validated export-based calculations?
research_questions: Do calculations reproduce independently worked examples, including blanks, qualifiers and failed controls?

already_counted.description: Actual sampling, field capture, testing and interpretation

incremental.description: Revalidate formula settings after method changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 minus 1 upkeep gives 9. Low 0 when the instrument already calculates the result or exports are unsuitable, leaving the present workflow unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A technician with less repeated file handling, re-keying and calculation, while retaining field observation and test validity work.
reach: Provide traceable sample evidence to environmental engineers
role.ambitious_version: Reliable environmental records that can be traced back to actual samples and observations.
